symbols.read: Bias flips from confirmed bullish to neutral-to-bearish: price at 344.12 has broken back below the 348.36 upper pivot that anchored the prior read, and the combined 1D+1H signal has downgraded from BUY to HOLD even though 1D direction and the 1H trend still read up. The prior entry at 348.36 is now overhead resistance rather than support, and with price below it the long setup is invalidated — the 346.54 stop sits above current price, so the structure that justified the bullish call no longer holds mechanically. Downside focus shifts to the 325.81 lower pivot, roughly 18 points below; reclaiming 348.36 on a close would revive the bullish case toward 370.91, but until then the bias is corrective within a NEUTRAL regime.

Bias remains bearish and the setup is essentially unchanged: price ticked up to 248.83 but is still capped below the bear FVG at 251.05–251.58, with the 1H trend down and the combined signal still SELL. The 248.82–248.90 FVG from the prior read is no longer listed as open, so price has filled into that zone without breaking structure — no pivot break, no trend flip. Entry at 244.72, stop at 246.86, and target at 224.11 all hold, keeping the watching short roughly 4.1 points from trigger. Plan unchanged: bearish below 265.34, a break of 244.72 triggers the short, and a push back above 265.34 invalidates it.

AVGO's bias stays bearish but unconfirmed, and the setup has weakened: price fell from 339.00 to 330.80, breaking back below the 338.03 top of the bearish FVG (330.82–338.03) and turning the 1H trend down, which resolves the prior 1H/1D conflict in the bears' favor. The 321.02 lower pivot remains intact, so the sell still only triggers on a break below it toward 261.20, with a reclaim of 324.57 invalidating the short. The two open bull FVGs at 324.80–325.20 and 327.82–329.48 sit just below price and are the immediate magnet and obstacle for any bounce. Bias confirmed bearish, later and lower rather than triggered; the key change from the prior read is the loss of 338.03 and the 1H flip down.

The BUY regime from the previous read is confirmed but has lost momentum: price slipped from 741.51 to 740.55, ceding the 740.55–741.00 reclaimed FVG and stalling below the new bull FVG at 742.51–743.66, which now acts as overhead supply rather than support. The 1H trend remains up but the last bar is negative (745.58→744.68), and the combined regime has softened from bullish alignment to HOLD, so the push toward 751.86 is delayed, not broken. Bias stays cautiously bullish above 739.40; reclaiming 743.66 reopens the path to 751.86, while losing 739.40 neutralizes the read and re-exposes 733.65/725.62. The SELL at 725.62 remains invalidated and irrelevant.

BRK.B stays on the BUY bias but has slipped to 569.56 from 574.23, still in clear air above the 549.96 upper pivot with the 1D Bullish and combined 1D+1H BUY intact. The 1H trend remains up and the last bar firmed to +0.26% from +0.12%, a marginal momentum improvement, though price drifting lower toward the pivot weakens the setup's cushion. Open FVGs remain empty, so there is still no unfilled shelf beneath price; entry 549.96 with stop 548.11 defines invalidation, and a break below that stop voids the bullish case. Upside target stays 603.96 with the regime still NEUTRAL.

Price has slipped to 79,962.39, breaking below the 80,451.18 lower pivot that capped the prior read — the fade toward 76,004.36 has now extended rather than stalled, confirming the neutral-to-soft-bearish lean. The 1H trend stays down and the 4H remains bearish, but the combined signal still reads HOLD with the setup INVALIDATED, so there is no clean fresh short at this level. A new bull FVG at 80,332.71–80,362.00 now sits just overhead, giving a structural buffer that did not exist before; a push back into and acceptance above that gap, and especially above the 80,646.25 stop, voids the bearish lean. Bias stays bearish while price holds below 80,451.18.

Price extended lower to 2,315.67 from 2,326.50, staying below the 2,351.55 lower pivot, so the bearish structure holds and the prior read's bias is confirmed. The 1H downtrend persists, but the last bar's marginal +0.04% move to 2,328.26 is a weak bounce that still fails to challenge the 2,352.9–2,354.32 bear FVG, and the NEUTRAL regime keeps conviction thin. The 2,176.48 target stands while price stays below 2,351.55; invalidation remains a reclaim of 2,351.55 that closes the FVG. The signal is still INVALIDATED, so this is a structural lean, not an active trigger.

Bias stays SELL and the setup has strengthened: price has extended its slide to 318.69, now clearly below the 322.00 lower pivot rather than hovering just under it, and the last 1H bar (320.47→319.23) confirms sellers kept pressing through the prior read's level. The 1H trend remains down and the combined 1D+1H stack is still bearish, with the 322.64–322.74 and 326.49–327.01 bearish FVGs unchanged overhead. The plan holds as entry 322.00, stop 324.54, target 284.60, with invalidation a reclaim above 324.54 that would clear immediate supply and break the bearish stack.

LLY has broken below the 1,321.21 upper pivot, with price now at 1,280.92 — a decisive invalidation of the prior buy-on-watch thesis, so the bias shifts from confirmed-long to a hold with the setup now dormant. The 1D direction and combined 1D+1H read remain bullish and the 1H trend is still up, but price sitting under the pivot means the entry at 1,321.21 is no longer live and the stop at 1,309.40 is above current price, so the trade is off rather than triggered. The new bear FVG at 1,269.36–1,273.33 and bull FVG at 1,269.36–1,274.12 mark the immediate battleground; holding above that zone keeps the bullish structure intact for a reclaim of 1,321.21, while a break below exposes the 1,131.21 lower pivot. Invalidation of any renewed long is a loss of the 1,269–1,274 FVG cluster, and the NEUTRAL regime still argues for waiting on a reclaim of 1,321.21 before re-engaging.

META's SELL bias is confirmed and upgraded from watching to active: price has dropped to 641.98, now just 2.29 above the 639.69 entry trigger, and the combined 1D+1H signal has flipped from HOLD to SELL as the 1H downtrend persisted (last hour 645.11→641.81). The bearish FVG at 648.42–650.38 remains the upside cap, with stop at 647.38 and target at 508.11, and the lower pivot at 639.69 is the only level standing between price and the entry. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim above 647.38 would push price back through the FVG and undercut the short.

MSFT has reversed the prior breakdown: price recovered from 527.50 to 531.05, the 1H trend flipped back up, and the combined signal moved from HOLD to BUY, so the neutral-to-bearish bias is revised back to cautiously bullish. The 1H close at 530.43 (+0.57%) confirms the bounce, and the new bullish FVG at 524.58–526.32 now sits beneath price as support rather than the absent gap-fill cited before. Bias is bullish short-term, but the setup is still only WATCHING — entry stays at 551.15 with stop 547.75 and target 605.05, so the trade does not trigger until price reclaims the upper pivot. Invalidation: a loss of the 524.58–526.32 FVG and then 497.25 would break the structure and flip the bias bearish again, while the 1D bullish direction remains intact for now.

Bias stays bearish but the short is now further from live, not closer: price at 215.15 has pushed up off the 211.26 lower pivot instead of breaking it, and the combined regime has flipped from SELL back to NEUTRAL, softening conviction. The key change versus the previous read is that price has climbed into the old bearish FVG zone that used to cap upside — that 214.17–215.09 band is now behind price, replaced by a fresh bearish FVG at 218.88–221.32 overhead, while two bull FVGs at 212.30–212.61 and 212.14–214.61 sit below as support. 1D direction and 1H trend both remain down, so the structure is intact, but the entry at 211.26 is now well below spot and the stop at 213.10 is already breached on price, meaning the setup as defined is stale and needs a fresh trigger nearer current levels. Invalidation of the bearish stance is a sustained hold above the 218.88–221.32 bearish FVG, which would signal the downtrend is being reclaimed; a drop back through the bull FVGs toward 211.26 would re-arm the original short.

Price has broken back below the 101.14 lower pivot to 101.11, and the 1H trend has flipped down again with the last bar closing lower at 101.90 — this confirms the bearish repair flagged as the trigger in the prior read, so the neutral HOLD is revised to SELL. The 4H remains bearish and the combined bias now aligns to SELL, with the 101.14–101.55 zone as the actionable entry/stop and 93.08 as the target. The open bull FVG at 101.67–101.86 sits just above as overhead supply that would need to fill for any bounce, and a reclaim of 109.20 remains the invalidation that kills the bearish case. Bias is bearish while price holds below 101.14.

TSLA's bias flips from neutral-watch to a confirmed long setup: price at 395.89 has closed above the 388.86 trigger, and the 1H trend has turned up, so the prior "stand aside until a close above 388.86" condition is now met. The 1D remains bullish and combined signal still reads HOLD, but the entry at 388.86 with stop 385.25 and target 431.84 is now live rather than pending. The last 1H leg is flat at 395.10→394.98 (-0.03%), a mild stall just above the trigger rather than a rejection, and the FVG field stays empty so there's no overhead drag. Invalidation is a close back below 388.86 (stop 385.25); a break of 345.88 would flip the broader structure bearish.

Price has pushed further below the 54.38 lower pivot to 54.10, deepening the bearish structure and confirming the prior bias rather than revising it. The key change is that a fresh bullish FVG at 53.99–54.07 has opened just below price, replacing the now-filled bearish gap and creating a downside magnet that supports the path toward the 50.14 target. The 1H trend stays down and the regime stays BEARISH, with the combined read still HOLD and the SELL setup expired, so no fresh entry is live. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained reclaim of 54.61 flips the short-term read neutral-to-bullish.

Price has slipped to 4,015.73 from 4,016.49, still grinding toward the 3,975.65 entry trigger without breaking it, so the setup remains a confirmed bearish watch rather than a live position. The bias stays bearish — 4H bearish, 1H down, combined SELL, regime BEARISH — and the 1H leg down (4,023.12→4,015.73) reinforces the drift toward entry. Key levels are unchanged: a clean break of 3,975.65 opens the path to 3,809.07, with the stop at 3,984.93, and invalidation remains a sustained reclaim above the 4,142.23 upper pivot. No open FVGs and no structural flip, so the prior read is confirmed, not revised; the only change is price edging marginally closer to the trigger.

The bias has flipped back to bearish: price at 1.29 has slipped below the 1.3075 reclaim level that confirmed the prior read's flip, the 1H trend has turned down, and the combined 4H+1H read is now SELL — a clean reversal of the neutralized stance. The 1.27 SELL is marked invalidated, so no live entry exists; the setup is a re-entry trigger, not a position. Key levels: a sustained break of 1.27 reopens 1.15 (stop 1.28), while reclaiming 1.3075 would again neutralize the bearish case toward the 1.40 upper pivot. Invalidation for the bearish bias is a hold back above 1.3075.
